MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Partners appeals to me for the vocal collaborations, which connect with my interest in musical and crossover singing.",
    "That's Life feels promising if it is a vocal standards album, because polished singing fits what I enjoyed in Stages and A Musical Affair."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Christmas albums connect with something I have enjoyed before, but I am not looking for seasonal music now.",
    "Legacy, Legacy, Vol. 2, The Very Best Of, and Playing With Fire do not give me enough evidence of the singing or sound I want to choose them.",
    "Down To My Last Bad Habit has some potential given my country listening, but it feels less suited to my current interest in relaxing music."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My earlier Christmas listening seems to have been treated as an ongoing desire for more Christmas albums.",
    "My past country listening seems to carry more weight than whether that music suits what I feel like hearing now."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent choice of relaxing classical music suggests that a calm listening experience matters to me right now.",
    "The connection that matters across my musical and crossover choices is expressive, polished singing; a broadly related album is not enough on its own."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The choices partly capture my interest in polished vocals, but lean too heavily on older seasonal interests and miss my current preference for relaxing listening."
}
